# SaltWatch Card 0.6.4

This release improves responsiveness in the Home Assistant Companion app while
preserving the card's existing appearance and behavior.

## What changed

- Reduced the amount of SVG content that mobile WebKit must repaint when the
  salt level or card data changes.
- Kept static tank effects separate from the frequently updated salt layer.
- Updated existing DOM content in place instead of rebuilding the complete
  card for routine state changes.
- Avoided repeated layout calculations when the card dimensions and threshold
  have not changed.

## Compatibility

- No configuration changes are required.
- The visual design, animations, actions, labels, thresholds, and fixed-height
  layouts are unchanged.
- The optimization applies to both SaltWatch device discovery and manually
  mapped water-softener entities.

## Validation

- 56 unit tests passed.
- Pixel comparisons in mobile WebKit matched exactly for initial, updated-level,
  threshold, unavailable, and fixed-height states.
- Routine mobile WebKit update time improved from about 85 ms to about 33 ms
  after warm-up in the test scenario.
- The production TypeScript and Vite build passed.
